answer: Because the age is read from the shale checkpoint rather than self-declared, the umber audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. An identity must be at least 7 epochs old on the pearl ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Running a farm thus means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
